rulings: CF-CARDNUMBER-ALONE-IS-NOT-IDENTITY (Beckett initials collide). CPA-DT names FOUR different cards in 2025: Diego Tornes (bowman-chrome), Devin Taylor (bowman-draft), Drew Thorpe (topps-chrome-platinum) and Dallas Turner (football topps-chrome). The number decides nothing; the player the title names decides the product.

CF-A-COLLISION-SALE-WITH-A-READABLE-PLAYER-GOES-TO-THAT-PLAYERS-ROW (Drew, 2026-09-05). Every entry here names Devin Taylor in its TITLE, so it belongs on the bowman-draft row; none of the 314 rows measured had NO readable identity, so this list parks nothing.

THE TITLE IS THE EVIDENCE, THE STORED FIELD IS NOT. repair-cpa-draft-refile reads playerName off the row and folds it with an EXACT playerKey(). 12 of the 314 cpa-dt rows carry a dirty playerName ('Draft Devin Taylor', 'Devin Taylor Oakland', 'Devin Taylor On Caes'), and ONE carries an outright wrong one ('Diego Tornes' on a title that reads 'Devin Taylor 2025 Bowman Chrome Draft 1st Auto Oakland Athletics'). Those four rows are exactly the ones the lane skips as to-key-checklist-does-not-name-this-player.

A DESTINATION MUST BE CHECKLIST-BACKED. 5 further Taylor rows are NOT relocated because their destination row does not exist in card_catalog: 'bowman-draft:cpa-dt:refractor:auto' (3 rows) and 'bowman-draft:cpa-dt:refractor:auto:num-150' (2). They are recorded in `deferred`, not routed — a repair never mints an identity from a sale.

THIS LIST IS A SUPERSET OF THE LANE, NEVER A CONFLICT WITH IT. Replaying planCrossProductSale over the same 212 chrome-stem rows: the lane MOVEs 9, and every one of those 9 is in this list with the same destination; it moves nothing this list does not. The 4 extra are the dirty-playerName rows above.
THE PRINT RUN AND THE PARALLEL NEVER MOVE. Every entry changes segment 4 (the product) and nothing else, which is the axis onlyProductSegmentMoves() enforces.
